name: SCL: 940 Warehouse Shipping Order (AM → X12 → DCG)

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key) VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupeKey }}')
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (correlation_id, doc_type, direction, partner, stream, status, external_ids, payload_ref)
  SELECT '{{ $json.correlationId }}', '{{ $json.docType }}', '{{ $json.direction }}', 'DCG', 'TEST', '{{ $json.status }}', '{{ $json.externalIds }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.fileName }}'
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.correlationId }}' AS correlation_id,
  (SELECT id FROM ins) IS NOT NULL AS is_new,
  (SELECT id FROM logged) AS transaction_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ConnectorId: 'c-71cf9ddb758b4376b', SendFilePaths: ['/scl-dcg-sftp-bridge/outbound/pending/' + $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.fileName], RemoteDirectoryPath: '/From_SCL_TEST' }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE transactions
SET status = 'sent'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.correlationId }}'
RETURNING id, correlation_id, status;

meta.instructions: Pulls up to 3 real AM pick tickets (falls back to one realistic sample if AM's test company has none yet), a generic AM customer lookup, and AM Inventory (to enrich pick-ticket lines with UPC + full color name, same combine pattern as the 888 flow -- pick_ticket_items alone has no UPC), ports adapters/edi/x12-dcg/lib/{envelope,itemCode,build940}.js into the 'Build 940 X12' Code node (runs ONCE PER pick ticket, unlike 888 which batches -- each pick ticket is its own 940 shipment). Dedupes/logs to Supabase per pick ticket, uploads each X12 file to S3, pushes it to DCG via StartFileTransfer. Known gaps (see adapters/edi/x12-dcg/schema-notes.md): customer name comes from a generic (unfiltered) AM customer lookup, not matched to the pick ticket's actual customerId -- AM's customers/ endpoint filter-by-ID capability hasn't been confirmed; several 940 fields (N1|BF, N1|SF, several N9 extensions) are deliberately omitted, no canonical PickTicket source. Also TBD: ISA sender/receiver IDs, and confirming transaction-type code 42 with Chi Cao (well-supported default, not yet explicitly confirmed). After import, re-select credentials: Query Auth account (Get AM Pick Tickets, Get AM Customer, Get AM Inventory), Postgres account (Claim & Log, Mark Sent), AWS account (Upload to S3, StartFileTransfer). Uses usageIndicator 'T' (test) and stream 'TEST' throughout. INLINE DELIVERY VERIFICATION: after StartFileTransfer, Wait 5s -> ListFileTransferResults -> Verify Transfer (DCG) confirms the file actually reached DCG (StartFileTransfer 200 only means AWS accepted the request). If the transfer FAILED (or no result yet), Verify throws -> execution fails -> the SCL: Error Alerts error workflow emails help@goodmove.xyz. Only a COMPLETED transfer proceeds to Mark Sent. Set this flow Settings -> Error Workflow = SCL: Error Alerts. Re-select the AWS account credential on ListFileTransferResults after import.
